# Walmart
> Walmart is a major retail and e-commerce platform for shopping products, managing orders, memberships, subscriptions, and household services.

Walmart.com combines online shopping across major retail categories with account tools, delivery and pickup services, Walmart+ membership benefits, registries, lists, pharmacy, and financial services. The site emphasizes low prices, convenience, and omnichannel shopping tied to local stores.

## Core Shopping
- [Homepage](https://www.walmart.com/): Main shopping entry point for products, deals, services, and account access.
- [All Departments](https://www.walmart.com/all-departments): Browse Walmart’s full department directory and category structure.
- [Grocery](https://www.walmart.com/cp/grocery/976759): Shop groceries, pantry items, beverages, and household essentials.
- [Electronics](https://www.walmart.com/cp/electronics/3944): Browse TVs, computers, audio, gaming, and tech accessories.
- [Home](https://www.walmart.com/cp/home/4044): Shop furniture, décor, kitchen, bedding, and home improvement items.
- [Clothing, Shoes & Accessories](https://www.walmart.com/cp/clothing/5438): Explore apparel, shoes, jewelry, and accessories for all ages.
- [Auto & Tires](https://www.walmart.com/cp/auto-tires/91083): Shop automotive parts, tires, tools, and vehicle accessories.
- [Baby](https://www.walmart.com/cp/baby/5427): Find diapers, feeding supplies, nursery items, and baby gear.

## Deals & Savings
- [Savings](https://www.walmart.com/shop/savings): Central hub for rollbacks, markdowns, and promotional savings.
- [Deals](https://www.walmart.com/shop/deals): Browse current Walmart deals across major product categories.
- [Flash Deals](https://www.walmart.com/shop/deals/flash-deals): Limited-time offers and short-duration promotional discounts.
- [Clearance](https://www.walmart.com/shop/clearance): Shop clearance products with reduced prices across departments.
- [Walmart+ Week](https://www.walmart.com/plus/week): Promotional event page for Walmart+ member-exclusive offers.
- [New & Trending](https://www.walmart.com/cp/new-trending/7689165): Discover popular, seasonal, and newly featured products.

## Walmart+ & Delivery
- [Walmart+](https://www.walmart.com/plus): Membership program with delivery, shipping, fuel, and streaming benefits.
- [Free Delivery from Store](https://www.walmart.com/plus/free-delivery): Overview of Walmart+ store delivery benefits and eligibility.
- [Free Shipping](https://www.walmart.com/plus/free-shipping): Details on shipping benefits included with Walmart+ membership.
- [Fuel Savings](https://www.walmart.com/plus/fuel): Information about member fuel discounts and participating stations.
- [Paramount+ Benefit](https://www.walmart.com/plus/paramount): Streaming benefit information for eligible Walmart+ members.
- [Walmart+ Assist](https://www.walmart.com/plus/assist): Discounted Walmart+ plan for customers receiving government assistance.

## Account, Orders & Personalization
- [My Items](https://www.walmart.com/my-items): Reorder and manage previously purchased and saved items.
- [Purchase History](https://www.walmart.com/orders): View orders, tracking, returns, and purchase history.
- [Lists](https://www.walmart.com/lists): Create and manage shopping lists and saved product collections.
- [Registries](https://www.walmart.com/my-registries): Manage gift registries for events and milestones.
- [Account Sign In](https://www.walmart.com/): Sign in or create an account to access Walmart services.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.walmart.com/cp/subscriptions/4191733): Manage recurring deliveries for frequently purchased essentials.

## Grocery Pickup & Delivery
- [Grocery Pickup & Delivery](https://www.walmart.com/cp/online-grocery-shopping/976759): Order groceries online for pickup or local delivery.
- [Pickup](https://www.walmart.com/cp/pickup/2281924): Learn about curbside pickup options and order fulfillment.
- [Delivery](https://www.walmart.com/cp/delivery/2281925): Explore same-day and scheduled delivery options from local stores.
- [SNAP EBT](https://www.walmart.com/cp/snap-online/1465096): Use SNAP EBT for eligible online grocery purchases.
- [Meal Solutions](https://www.walmart.com/cp/meal-solutions/976759): Shop ingredients and prepared options for meal planning.

## Pharmacy & Health
- [Pharmacy](https://www.walmart.com/cp/pharmacy/5431): Access pharmacy services, prescriptions, and health-related shopping.
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.walmart.com/cp/health/976760): Shop health products, medicine, personal care, and wellness essentials.
- [Vision Center](https://www.walmart.com/cp/vision-center/1087266): Explore vision services, eyewear, and optical products.
- [Pet Pharmacy](https://www.walmart.com/cp/pet-pharmacy/5431): Shop prescription and health products for pets.
- [Medicare Advantage](https://www.walmart.com/cp/medicare-advantage/8477699): Information related to Medicare Advantage plan offerings.

## Financial Services
- [Money Services](https://www.walmart.com/cp/money-services/5433): Access bill pay, money transfers, check cashing, and related services.
- [OnePay](https://www.walmart.com/cp/onepay/9435689): Learn about Walmart-linked financial products and account offerings.
- [Credit Card](https://www.walmart.com/cp/credit-card/632402): Information about Walmart credit card options and benefits.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.walmart.com/cp/gift-cards/96894): Buy physical and digital gift cards for Walmart purchases.
- [Tax Prep Services](https://www.walmart.com/cp/tax-prep-services/1072864): Find tax preparation-related services and seasonal resources.

## Services & Store Tools
- [Store Finder](https://www.walmart.com/store/finder): Locate Walmart stores, hours, and local store services.
- [Auto Care Center](https://www.walmart.com/cp/auto-care-center-services/1087266): Learn about in-store auto maintenance and tire services.
- [Photo Center](https://www.walmart.com/cp/photo-services/1334134): Order prints, photo gifts, and personalized photo products.
- [Installation Services](https://www.walmart.com/cp/installation-services/4044): Browse available installation and assembly service options.
- [Protection Plans](https://www.walmart.com/cp/protection-plans/1231920): Review product protection plans and coverage information.
- [Returns](https://www.walmart.com/help/article/returns/3b2d0d4d2f5f4f0e9f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f): Help information for returns, refunds, and exchanges.

## Help & Policies
- [Help Center](https://www.walmart.com/help): Main support hub for orders, account, delivery, and policies.
- [Contact Us](https://www.walmart.com/help/contact-us): Customer support contact options and assistance channels.
- [Shipping](https://www.walmart.com/help/article/shipping/9f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f): Help information about shipping methods and delivery timing.
- [Pickup Help](https://www.walmart.com/help/article/pickup/7f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f): Support information for pickup orders and store collection.
- [Walmart+ Help](https://www.walmart.com/help/article/walmart/4f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f): Support resources for Walmart+ membership and benefits.
- [Accessibility](https://www.walmart.com/help/article/accessibility/6f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f): Accessibility information and support resources for Walmart customers.
